method: EC stations excluded from seven-station template construction; predict arrivals with same FMM approximation and elevation correction
controls: 500 within-hour shared-catalog time shifts; independent offset per UTC hour; 60..3540 seconds circular
gap_policy: real common three-component segments; exclude 5-second blind edges
limitations: Pick model shared across networks but observed waveforms independent
Approximate inherited locations affect arrival residuals
Missing heldout support is not proof of false detection
Time control assumes approximate stationarity within each hour
No heldout-trained tuning or manual earthquake labels
